lines.en: I wake up again. A wonderful start to the day.
I stare at the girl in front of me who, in what I imagine is a vast departure from normal, fell asleep with her makeup on.
Sunlight leaks in through a small paper window and informs me that it’s morning.
Or, in more depressing terms- time to leave.
It’s unfortunate that this getaway was only for one night, but I’m sure that there will be plenty more just like it in the future.
I just have to hope Chika decides to call into more radio shows.
Of course, there’s always the chance for me to just...buy tickets to places like this...
But where’s the fun in that?
It’s much better to have things dropped into your lap than it is to work for them.
You’re probably used to hearing that sort of opinion from me by now, aren’t you?
Which means that you probably understand that it’s time for me to, once again, butcher the words of someone much smarter than I am.
I believe it was Thoreau who said, “It is not worth the while to go round the world to count the cats in Zanzibar.”
Now, when he said this, he probably meant something along the lines of “It’s better to search within yourself for what you want than to go greatly out of your way for it.”
Why someone would be so dedicated to counting cats, I don’t understand.
So I’m going to chalk his words up to insanity and repurpose them to fit my own narrative.
Don’t work hard because working hard sucks.
Buy your own cats and count them.
There. Problem solved.
I spit on Thoreau’s grave from my place beside a naked [teenager] and wish away my morning erection.
It probably sounds hard to believe, but after last night, the last thing I want is to have sex right now.
And I worry that if Chika wakes up and sees that her new best friend is already fully erect, I may never fuck again.
Just how long is she going to sleep for, though?
What time even is it right now?
I reach over to grab my phone out of my pants (Which are conveniently only several feet away) and find that it’s just after 6:00 AM.
Also, my phone is about to die because I passed out without plugging it in last night.
I sigh to myself and bring my face closer to hers, hoping that she wakes up and quells this boredom soon.
I’d hate to be the one to disturb her slumber, but I honestly might have to at this rate.
Sometimes, I feel like I’ll waste away if I just stay in bed.
Like I’ll disintegrate and turn into sand.
And then, before I know it, girls will be having their hearts broken as they confess their feelings on top of me.
Thankfully, I managed to avoid that same tragedy last night.
Though, it was in a way that would not quite turn to glass if heated thoroughly.
My mind connects the word “thorough” to “Thoreau” and I loop back to the idea of cats and Zanzibar.
God, I hope Chika wakes up soon.
All of the cats die and I don’t have to count anything anymore.
: Sen...sei...
: Chi...ka...
: Mm...what time is it?
: It’s a little after 6:00 AM.
: So...early...
: Goodnight...
: You can’t say goodnight when the sun is rising.
: Good...sun...
: That’s not even a thing.
Huh.
All this time, I thought Chika was a morning person.
She’s always waking up early to make breakfast and...listening to radio shows with Chinami and-
I wonder if maybe she’s only sleeping in now because she rarely ever has the chance to?
But...then again, it is 6:00 AM.
I guess it doesn’t really constitute sleeping in until it’s around...10:00 AM, I guess?
Wait.
How come you can sleep in but not out?
: Chika, please wake up. I can’t do this anymore.
: Wha?...Do what?...
: Do you wanna...have sex again?...
: No. I’m pretty sure both of us would die.
: Sex~
: Yes, Chika. That is a thing we did...many, many times last night.
: You’re a...good...sex guy...
: Thank you very much for that completely normal compliment.
: Sex man...
: Wow, you’re really out of it, aren’t you?
: Pancakes...
: You want breakfast?
: Chinami likes...pancakes...
: Gotta...make her some...
: Chinami isn’t here right now, Chika. We’re at the onsen.
: Call...Yumi...
: About the...pancakes...
: My phone is basically dead.
: Also, I don’t even have her number.
: Mmm...I’ll do it...
: I’m...up now.
: Good morning, Sensei~
: Good morning, Chika.
: Did you enjoy our first night together?
: I’m sure I’ll be remembering this for the rest of my life.
: Heheh~ I’m glad...
: Hey, do you think they have a gift shop downstairs?
: A gift shop? I don’t remember seeing one. Do you want a snack or something?
: I need a morning after pill.
: Oh.
: Uhh.
: Unless you want me to drop out, marry you, have a baby, and then move into Ami’s room.
: I can’t say I want any of those things right now.
: I didn’t think so.
: It’ll just be for this one time.
: I’ll start taking birth control now that I know we’re going to be “sexually active” together.
: I’m glad you didn’t suggest something as outrageous as a condom.
: Why would I do that when having you cum in me feels so good?
: Okay, time to change the topic before I-
: Wait. Too late. It’s hard again.
: Oh nooo~ Whatever will we do?
: Nothing right now.
: What if I’m really, really gentle?
: Hands to yourself, woman. I can’t have you turning into a nymphomaniac on me.
: Hey! Just because you came in me like ten times last night and we passed out totally naked and covered in sweat doesn’t mean I’m any less wholesome than I was last week!
: It...kind of does, though.
: Nuh-uh.
: I am not going to argue with you about this.
: Put it in me or face the consequences, [chikamaster].
: What kind of consequences would even come from this?
: I only pretend to take the morning after pill and just let myself get pregnant.
: That is...way too huge of a thing to do out of spite.
: I’m obviously kidding, Sensei. I can barely take care of Chinami.
: I’m not a nympho, though. So don’t go saying anything like that to anybody.
: Who would I even say that to?
: I mean, you can talk about what we did to whoever you want. I don’t care.
: Like, I’ve obviously gotta tell Yumi.
: I’m sorry, what?
: She’s my best friend and this was like, a super big deal. I totally have to tell her.
: I...don’t think that’s a good idea.
: Why not? Cause she always acts all tough and talks about not liking you?
: That’s only like, half-serious. You know that, right?
: That is still enough seriousness for me to think it’s better if she doesn’t know that we’re having sex.
: I mean...I can probably leave out the sex part, but...
: I can still tell her you’re my boyfriend now, right?
Uh-oh.
It appears we have a...dramatic misunderstanding about our future together.
But how am I supposed to come out and say something like “Oh, I’m not your boyfriend, but thanks for telling me you loved me and letting me cum in you a bunch of times?”
How the fuck do I get out of this?
: Why do you want to tell her anyway?
: Because I love her. And I love you.
: And I want all of us to be happy together.
: And you think Yumi knowing about us is going to make her happy?
: I don’t think it would make her...not happy?
: I kind of think she’d oust the both of us.
: Yumi? No way, she-
: Wait...you’re not like...embarrassed of me, are you?
: What? Not at all. I think you’re amazing.
: But I don’t think it would be safe for anyone else to really know just yet. And that’s including Yumi.
: I...don’t want to keep this a secret from Yumi, Sensei.
: You probably don’t get it since you’re a guy, but I need to like...I don’t know, mark my territory, I guess?
: Do you...think Yumi is going to make a move on me or something?
: Not at all. But I don’t think it’s impossible for her to like, wind up liking you or whatever.
: I don’t think she’d do something like that to me since the two of us are so close, but like-
: If she knows we’re already together, it might prevent things from ever progressing that far.
: I really don’t think you need to worry about that happening, Chika.
: Hmm...
: Okay. It looks like we need to compromise.
: How about this?
: I won’t go out of my way to tell her...but if it ever comes up in conversation, I’m not going to lie to her about it.
: It’s not like Yumi ever really wants to talk about stuff like that anyway.
: And even if I do wind up telling her, I’ll make sure she never even thinks about mentioning it to the other girls.
: She’s surprisingly loyal. And I don’t think she’d ever want to hurt either one of us.
Well-
It’s better than nothing, I guess.
I mean, Yumi already assumes I’m having sex with the entire class anyway.
So having one of the girls confirmed (If things do come to that), likely won’t change much.
And, as far as the boyfriend thing goes-
I don’t think it’s necessarily bad to let Chika go on thinking that.
I mean, I’m sure the other girls I’m involved with look at me the same way as well.
They just haven’t come out and said it.
But that’s what sets Chika apart from the others.
She’s mature enough to set her sights on something and then just...take it without thinking of how it will affect anyone else.
It’s actually kind of relentless.
I admire her.
: Yeah. Okay.
: Let’s just try and keep it as secretive as possible until [high_school] is over.
: Heheh~ I never would have imagined my [high_school] sweetheart would be my teacher.
: And I never would have imagined we’d end up in a position like this after our first meeting at the mall.
That’s a lie. I imagined this a lot.
: Really?
: So you didn’t go home and rub one out to me?
: Nope. Definitely not a thing that’s ever happened.
: Weird. Cause I totally did.
: Oh, come on. I literally just stopped being hard.
: Sensei, as long as the two of us are together, you can kinda count on getting hard pretty much all the time.
: I’m gonna make your life Hell from now on.
: Yeah, that sounds like a real nightmare.
: Heheh~ Just wait until I start sending you naughty pictures of myself in the middle of class.
: Wow, the nightmare never ends.
Chika laughs and hops out of the futon, making her way into the living room and rearranging some of the furniture we may have...knocked around last night.
I think about helping, but decide to bask in the stray sunlight for a moment longer.
And, once I’m able to do so without much of an...obstacle, I put my pants back on and head over to meet her.
: Why am I suddenly the only one that’s naked?
: Why are you still naked and reaching for your bag as if you’re ready to leave?
: Am I not supposed to walk back to the front office like this?
: It’s not like I can wear the yukata anymore.
: Definitely don’t do that.
: Jealous somebody else might see me?
: That and I don’t want us to be arrested for indecent exposure.
: People get naked in the hot spring, though. I’m sure they wouldn’t mind if we do it in the lobby.
: Uh-huh. And what about the bus stop that’s right outside of the building?
: What about it?
: Are you going to wait outside like that as well?
: Chika.
: Oh my God, Sensei. Do you really not understand a joke when you hear it?
: It’s kind of sad, though...
: Like...I really don’t want to leave.
: I had so much fun yesterday.
: Even if all we did was...you know...each other.
: Hey, that’s not all we did. You took that extremely long bath as well.
: Yeah...
: And that was...somehow just as good...
I stand there for a moment as Chika gets dressed, trying to come to terms with how a bath can be just as good as having sex with me.
I know Chika can get a little...crazy...but-
Am I...not enough for her?
Just what the hell is that girl into?
We make our way back to the lobby and hand in our room key.
I wound up carrying the TV down as well since the person who brought it up while Chika was away seemed far too old to be doing manual labor like that.
And...
Well, I guess that’s it.
It was short. It was sweet.
It was definitely a vacation.
: Have everything? Not forgetting anything in the room?
: Not that I’m aware of.
: I mean, it’s not like I really brought anything to begin with.
: How about you?
: Nope! Totally good.
: Guess...that’s that then.
: Cool, so what are we waiting for?
: I was...
: Kinda just hoping to...
: Oh! Good morning, you two.
: Oh, hey!
: I was just hoping I’d run into you one last time.
: Another example of fate, perhaps?
: Good morning, Mister.
: Would you be willing to discuss with me what game you two were playing last night?
: It sounded very exciting.
: Tsukasa...how many times do I have to tell you? They were playing a game for adults.
: You...uhh...
: You heard all that?
: You two...sure are lively.
: Hahah...hah...hah...
: This totally isn’t embarrassing at all...
: I am...sorry you had to hear all that.
: Oh, there’s no need to apologize.
: Lovers will be lovers.
: And Chika, dear...I forgot to bring it up yesterday, but I’d be happy to exchange contact information with you in the event that you’d want to meet up for lunch or something of the sort.
: Please forgive me if I’m overstepping my bounds by saying that.
: No! Not at all! I’d like, totally love that!
: How about I leave you two alone for a little while?
: To say goodbye, I mean.
: I’ll only be a few minutes. I promise.
: No worries. I’ll just wait outside.
: It was nice meeting you.
: It’s been a pleasure meeting you as well. Truly.
: Bye-bye! Please try to be a little more quiet when you play games in the future!
: Right...
I head outside and come to terms with the trip being over.
Chika spends the next five or so minutes talking to the girls inside.
And while I can’t say for certain that I understand why, I’ve got a pretty good idea.
Teenage girls are fragile.
Sometimes, they require fully grown specimens to latch onto so they don’t float off into the air and get sucked into a jet engine.
I don’t think Chika is close to floating away any time soon.
Especially now that the two of us are...whatever we are.
I’m sure our respective answers to that would be slightly different.
But I’m glad she seems to have found someone else to latch onto.
Frankly, I’d like to latch onto Tsubasa as well.
Albeit in an immensely less wholesome way.
But thoughts like that will have to wait until there aren’t feelings at stake.
For now...I’ll just-
I see a group of cats off in the distance.
Chika’s affection has increased to [chika_love]!
The trip to the onsen has come to an end.
You have received a photo from Chika to commemorate the occasion!
My stop comes first.
I get off the bus and watch Chika fade from my sight.
But not before giving her a few thousand yen for a morning after pill.
